risk_if_not_implemented: Without Embedded Sensor Configuration Verification, embedded and IoT technologies may operate with unknown, insecure or unmonitored configurations, creating exploitable footholds. Based on the risk and threat mapping for this control, this deficiency most likely exposes the organization to Unauthorized Access (R-AC-4), Loss of Confidentiality (R-IP-2), Privacy Harm / Unauthorized Processing (R-IP-6), and most likely increases susceptibility to Malicious Cyber Activity (MT-2), Human Error (MT-9).

compensating_control_1.name: Physical & Environmental Protections
compensating_control_1.description: Mechanisms exist to facilitate the operation of physical and environmental protection controls.
compensating_control_1.justification: Physical & Environmental Protections (PES-02) provides physical access control that compensates for the absence of Sensor Delivery Verification (CFG-18.4) by preventing unauthorized physical interaction with systems and infrastructure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.

compensating_control_2.name: Least Functionality
compensating_control_2.description: Mechanisms exist to configure Technology Assets, Applications and/or Services (TAAS) to provide only essential capabilities by specifically prohibiting or restricting the use of ports, protocols, and/or services.
compensating_control_2.justification: Least Functionality (CFG-03) provides configuration hardening that compensates for the absence of Sensor Delivery Verification (CFG-18.4) by eliminating unnecessary services and enforcing secure settings to reduce inherent exposure. Given the technology-focused nature of this control, this compensating control targets the same underlying risk objective through an alternative approach, helping to maintain an acceptable level of residual risk until the primary control can be implemented.
